What this means

Rainfall alone cannot replace longer paired observations. The test contains one short monsoon window and applies one city-centre rainfall cell to every anonymized well.

What would change the result

Data that can materially improve the right-hand graph

01Longer overlap

At least two complete wet and dry cycles for the same wells.

02Well coordinates

Enough location precision to assign a nearby rainfall grid or gauge.

03Ground gauges

KSNDMC or local gauge rainfall and intensity instead of one coarse city value.

04Recovery protocol

Consistent readings after a known pump-off duration.

The rainfall comparison uses only rainfall known before each predicted session. Rainfall features were selected on 24–25 July and measured on 26–29 July. Future rainfall lines are historical dry, typical and wet scenarios, not weather forecasts.
